text:
Ashley (Engineering): Quick heads up — I submitted my resignation today. My last day will be 2024-04-30. Want to start the offboarding checklist now so nothing slips. I have questions re: COBRA timing, RSU vesting, and cross-border benefits (I’m moving back to the UK).
Jordan (Manager): Really sorry to see you go, Ashley — we'll coordinate handoff. Can you paste your preferred shipping address for laptop return?
Ashley (Engineering): Thanks Jordan. Shipping address is 14 Brook Lane, Bristol, BS1 4AA (UK). Also curious if final paycheck covers prorated bonus and how 401(k)/pension paperwork works for a UK move.
Megan (People Ops): Hi Ashley — we’ll run through everything. I’ll send the formal offboarding form in DM but listing key items here: COBRA window (US): 60 days to elect from termination date; coverage end is last day of employment unless on leave. For UK move we'll coordinate pension/benefits termination separately. RSU/vest: we'll loop in Stock Ops, vesting cutoff is last timestamp on payroll on your final day.
Megan (People Ops): Action items for you: 1) Fill our offboard form (I'll DM link) 2) Confirm shipping address (Jordan confirmed) 3) Tell us if there's any legal hold on your projects 4) Upload any prompts/credentials to the handoff doc.
Omar (IT): @Ashley — noted for the laptop. Please confirm device serial and whether you have any company monitors/peripherals to return. For a UK pickup, we can create a prepaid label (DHL/UPS).
Ashley (Engineering): Laptop serial C02XQ7ABCDEF, has company monitor + dock. Yes please on prepaid label. Do I need to factory wipe before shipping?
Omar (IT): Don't wipe it yourself — we need to preserve device inventory and do a secure wipe centrally. Steps: 1) Sign the courier label when it arrives 2) Remove any personal files you want to keep (we will not look for personal content) 3) Leave laptop powered off and in original packaging if available. We'll handle remote wipe after receipt.
Ben (Payroll): @Ashley — final payroll notes: final regular pay will run on the normal schedule following your last day. Any outstanding PTO will be paid out per policy, and prorated bonus (if applicable) is processed after close-of-period review. For equity tax/UK specifics, Stock Ops will advise on tax withholding but we’ll provide the final payroll dump early May.
Ashley (Engineering): For COBRA — since I'm moving out of the US, is COBRA required? I think I might not be eligible if I’m abroad, but want to be sure for dependents still US-based.
Megan (People Ops): Good question. COBRA is tied to the US health plan enrollment and your last date of coverage. If you/your dependents remain US residents, they can elect COBRA. If you completely leave the US and terminate US coverage, COBRA may not be practical — we’ll send the standard COBRA notice and you can elect or decline. I’ll attach the benefits FAQ link in the DM.
Ashley (Engineering): Can you confirm the COBRA election deadline relative to termination date? I want to make sure I don’t miss it while traveling.
Megan (People Ops): COBRA election notice window is 60 days from the date the election notice is sent or from the date of loss of coverage (whichever is later). We send the notice within 7 business days of term processing. We will also email and slack you the enrollment link.
Jordan (Manager): Ashley — please book a 90-min knowledge-transfer session with me and Priya for docs & runbook handoff next week. Also share outstanding PRs you want us to prioritize.
Ashley (Engineering): Will do. I’ll draft a single handoff doc and link it in the offboard form.
Ben (Payroll): Also flagging: if you have any stock elections that require address confirmation, send Stock Ops a UK address only after you confirm tax residency. They will respond with steps.
Megan (People Ops): Copying Stock Ops is on my list. Also, Ashley — RSU cliff/vesting: if you have mid-period vesting, we typically pro-rate based on last active day; Stock Ops will confirm exact cutoff.
Omar (IT): Quick note for access removal: Okta + GSuite + GitHub + Slack will be scheduled for deprovisioning at 02:00 UTC on 2024-05-01 (approx 24 hours after your last day). If you need short-term access for any final tasks, tell us when and we can delay by request.
Ashley (Engineering): I need CI build access for a couple final merges until midday on 2024-04-30. Please keep GitHub and CI until then.
Omar (IT): Confirmed — we'll set deprov window to 2024-05-01 02:00 UTC and exclude GitHub/CircleCI until 2024-04-30 13:00 UTC.
IT Oncall Bot: Scheduled deprovision job queued: user=ashley@redwood.ai, deprovision_time=1717228800 (2024-05-01 02:00 UTC)
Ashley (Engineering): One more — where do I find the COBRA enrollment link? I’ll need to forward to my spouse in case they elect.
Megan (People Ops): I just DM’d you the COBRA packet and the benefits termination FAQ. Also emailed the official COBRA notice to your personal email on file. If your spouse wants to enroll, they can do so from that link; we can counsel on payment & timeline.
Ashley (Engineering): Thanks — appreciate the clarity. Also, can someone confirm if I should return the company phone? I have a burner company phone that I'll hand over.
Omar (IT): Yes — company phone is part of equipment. If you prefer, include it in the same shipment; we'll send a label that covers both laptop + phone + monitor.
Megan (People Ops): Final checklist summary for Ashley: 1) Fill offboard form (DM link) 2) Confirm shipping address (done) 3) Confirm any legal hold (reply here) 4) Schedule KT with Jordan/Priya (Ashley) 5) Expect COBRA notice + enrollment link within 7 business days 6) Payroll will send final pay details in early May.
Ashley (Engineering): All set on my end. Thanks everyone for the fast responses. 
Jordan (Manager): Huge thanks for everything you shipped here, Ashley. We’ll make the handoff smooth. :heart:
Megan (People Ops): We’ll follow up in DM with the links and the formal offboard timeline. If anything urgent comes up, @people-ops channel is the fallback.
